# Guaso blocks registry (@guaso)

> Source: https://github.com/guaso-ai/guaso-blocks
> Content data plane (not UI): https://github.com/guaso-ai/guaso-content (`@guaso-ai/content`)

## Install

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add @guaso/block-zone @guaso/rich-section @guaso/cta @guaso/gallery @guaso/cards @guaso/testimonials
```

Configure `components.json` registries:

```json
{ "registries": { "@guaso": "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/guaso-ai/guaso-blocks/main/r/{name}.json" } }
```

## Canonical block types (5)

| Registry item | Block `type` | Role |
|---------------|--------------|------|
| `@guaso/block-zone` | — | Zone + registry map + `blocksFromEntry` + `safeHref` |
| `@guaso/rich-section` | `RichSection` | Title/body markdown + optional CTA/image |
| `@guaso/gallery` | `Gallery` | Image grid (`url`/`alt`/`caption`) |
| `@guaso/cards` | `Cards` | Card grid with optional safe links |
| `@guaso/testimonials` | `Testimonials` | Quote/author/role grid |
| `@guaso/cta` | `CTA` | Headline/subtext/button |

Unknown `type` → ignored (forward-compat). Empty content + `isOwner` → placeholder; public empty → null.

## Data shapes

Aligned to Guaso `_CANONICAL_BLOCKS` (backend). Do not invent props outside that schema.

## Tokens

CROSS_TEMPLATE semantic tokens only (`text-foreground`, `text-primary`, `bg-primary`, `font-heading`, `border-border`, `bg-card`, `text-muted-foreground`, `text-primary-foreground`). No hex, lucide, or template skins — skins live in `guaso-template-*` (#3065).

- README.md — human install + layout
